title: This Bizarre Jurassic “Squid” Swam the Ancient Seas of Wyoming - Nautilus
gist: A study in Papers in Palaeontology describes Wyoteuthis linsterorum, a new belemnite species from Wyoming's roughly 160-million-year-old Sundance formation. Its rostrum girth of 2.4 inches makes it the chunkiest belemnite ever found, and it likely ate smaller cephalopods.
